reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Fine-Grained RBAC for application `update` and `delete` sub-resources: The default behavior of fine-grained policies have changed so they no longer apply to…", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: permission-lost

consequence.statement: RBAC policies granting update or delete permissions on Applications no longer automatically grant those permissions on managed sub-resources; operators must define separate policies with update/* or delete/* verbs to maintain access to application-managed resources.
consequence.remediation: Define new RBAC policies with update/* and delete/* verbs for managed resources, or set server.rbac.disableApplicationFineGrainedRBACInheritance to false in argocd-cm to preserve v2 behavior.

proposed.statement: Fine-grained RBAC policies granting update or delete to an Application no longer apply to its sub-resources by default; new policies granting update/* or delete/* are required for managed resources, with v2 behavior restorable via server.rbac.disableApplicationFineGrainedRBACInheritance=false in argocd-cm.
